proof: Set width1 and length L=sqrt3. The unchanged thirds put fold endpointsP=(L/3,0),Q=(2L/3,1). The fold line is y=sqrt3*x-1.
Reflection is R(x,y)=(-x/2+sqrt3*y/2+sqrt3/2, sqrt3*x/2+y/2-1/2). The folded left quadrilateral has vertices(L/2,-1/2),P,Q,(L,0).

The stationary right quadrilateral has verticesP,(L,0),(L,1),Q. Their intersection is triangleP,(L,0),Q of areaL/3. Material area remainsL; union areaB=L-L/3=2L/3. Folding the other half gives the same union area by reflection. Therefore B:A=2:3, choiceC.
